No import sticker, serial tag close-up, or usage log shown; origin cannot be confirmed from photos.

claims.evidence: Generic marketing language; no functional test or spec sheet shown.

risks.proof: Video of power-on, test copy, and scan with timestamp

Photo of internal counter/service menu showing total count
Photo of full accessory set laid out together

risks.risk: Hidden physical damage under plastic wrap
risks.proof: Photos with wrap removed from all sides

risks.risk: Model identity mismatch between seller text and visible nameplate
risks.proof: Close-up zoom of nameplate/model sticker and serial number
risks.if_unproven: priced strictly as AR-M207, the model actually shown

proof_requests: Clear zoomed photo of the model/serial nameplate
Video of power-on and a live test copy/print/scan
Photos with plastic wrap removed on all sides
Photo of all included accessories (cables, trays, manual)
Screenshot of internal page/copy counter if accessible
response.reason: Witness consistently identifies the unit as a Sharp AR-M207 photocopier, so it can be priced at worst case as that model despite the seller's unsupported claim of 'M307'; functional and condition risks remain unverified and should be priced conservatively until proven.
